scene.description: Vertical 4:5 cinematic editorial photograph, shot at an outdoor event venue at golden hour. Foreground, lower-middle of the frame: a close shot of an event organizer, a woman in her thirties in a smart-casual linen blazer, seen from the chest up and slightly from the side, holding a wooden clipboard with a printed checklist in her left hand and a pen in her right hand. The pen tip hovers a few centimetres above the line that reads BANHEIROS, about to strike it through; her gaze is down at the clipboard, expression focused and hesitant. The checklist shows five printed lines: Buffet, Som e DJ and Decoração already ticked, then BANHEIROS (the only line clearly legible, not yet ticked), then Convites. Background, softly blurred but fully recognisable, divided in two halves by a vertical line at the centre of the frame: LEFT half is a row of three generic blue plastic portable construction-site toilets on dusty ground, cool desaturated blue-grey light, slightly dirty; RIGHT half is a white luxury mobile restroom trailer with metal steps and warm decorative lighting, on clean green lawn, warm golden light. The trailer on the right must replicate IMAGEM 1 exactly. Palette: cool blue-grey on the left, warm gold and white on the right, navy #0F1D45 gradient at the top for text.
